def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("inputs must be two-dimensional")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("input shapes must match")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("future horizon must be at least 1")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("all input values must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float, not boolean")
    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("weight sum must be positive")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted averages
    avg_with = np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    avg_call_only = np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    avg_no_call = np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Margins: minimum improvement over no_call and call_only
    margin = np.minimum(avg_with - avg_no_call, avg_with - avg_call_only)

    # Keep if margin > threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
